name: Potion of Healing (Supreme)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Bonus Action to drink or give to a creature within 5 ft: regain 10d4 + 20 Hit Points.
text: The red liquid restores 10d4 + 20 Hit Points to whoever drinks it. Drinking it yourself, or feeding it to someone else within 5 feet, takes a Bonus Action.
